LegalEntityIdentifier.name: Legal Entity Identifier
LegalEntityIdentifier.definition: Identification of the fund/sub fund with a Legal Entity Identifier. This is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 "Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)".

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the fund/sub fund, assigned under a formal or proprietary identification scheme.

EstimatedTotalNAV.name: Estimated Total NAV
EstimatedTotalNAV.definition: Estimated total value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, of the fund/sub fund.

PreviousTotalNAV.name: Previous Total NAV
PreviousTotalNAV.definition: Previous total value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, of the fund/sub fund.

EstimatedTotalUnitsNumber.name: Estimated Total Units Number
EstimatedTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Estimated total number of units of the fund/sub fund.

PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.name: Previous Total Units Number
PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Previous total number of units of the fund/sub fund.

EstimatedPercentageOfFundTotalNAV.name: Estimated Percentage Of Fund Total NAV
EstimatedPercentageOfFundTotalNAV.definition: Estimated consolidated net cash flow expressed as a percentage of the previous total NAV for the fund/sub fund.

FundIdentification1Rule.definition: If Identification is not present, then Name or LegalEntityIdentifier must be present. Identification, Name and Legal Entity Identifier may all be present.

FundIdentification2Rule.definition: If Name is not present, then Identification or Legal Entity Identifier must be present. Identification, Name and Legal Entity Identifier may all be present.

FundIdentification3Rule.definition: If Legal Entity Identifier is not present, then Identification or Name must be present. Identification, Name and Legal Entity Identifier may all be present.
